aliases: Sword dragon's corpse Desolate beast sword dragon

summary.text: A sword dragon corpse is the dead body of a sword path desolate beast sword dragon, sold and used as immortal material.

claims.text: Fang Yuan has a dead desolate beast before him: a silver dragon about twenty feet long, two-clawed, with a spear-sharp horn, pure white eyes, and metallic scales, emitting a cold sharpness. It is a sword path desolate beast, the sword dragon, already dead, with its sword path dao marks gradually dissipating into the surroundings. The desolate beast sword dragon is full of sword path dao marks and is itself an immortal material that can be refined into Immortal Gu. Fang Yuan’s refinement path attainment is not high enough, and with only this sword dragon the immortal materials to refine the relevant Immortal Gu are also insufficient, so he refines only mortal Gu to support change form Immortal Gu.

This dragon Fang Yuan obtained was dead: he waited a long time in treasure yellow heaven before finding someone selling it, and he paid a considerable price to buy it. Only a living dragon can send out breath usable as material for dragon breath Gu, so a dead corpse cannot supply that ingredient. Fang Yuan specifically refines the required Gu such as dragon scale Gu and dragon claw Gu from the sword dragon’s corpse, which lets him activate sword dragon transformation more quickly and conveniently.
